title: Up, down or the same
summary: Follow a tune as it climbs, falls or stays put, and copy its shape.

hook.text: Every tune has a shape. Some climb like stairs. Some slide down like a slide. Some stay on one level. Press the keys from left to right and you have drawn a staircase. Can you draw a slide?

explore.text: Make three little tunes with three keys each. First one that climbs, each key higher than the last. Then one that falls. Then one that stays on the same key.
explore.goal: Play a tune that goes up, one that goes down and one that stays the same.

cards.text: A tune can go up: each sound is [[high|higher]] than the one before. It can go down: each sound is [[low|lower]]. Or it can stay the same: the same [[pitch|pitch]] again and again.
On the [[keyboard|keyboard]], going up means moving to the right. Going down means moving to the left. Staying the same means pressing the same key again.
Most tunes mix all three. *Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star* repeats a sound, climbs up, then falls back down. Hum it and feel your voice rise and fall.

alternative.text: Use your hand. Hum a sound and slide it higher: your hand rises, so the tune goes up. Slide it lower: your hand falls, so it goes down. Hold one sound steady: your hand stays flat, so it stays the same.

questions.prompt: Does the tune go up, go down or stay the same?
questions.hint: Hum along with the three sounds. Does your voice rise, fall or stay put?

questions.prompt: Match each shape to what it means.
questions.hint: Compare each sound with the one before it. Is it higher, lower or the same?

left.reason: Going up means each sound is higher than the one before.
Going down means each sound is lower than the one before.
Staying the same means every sound is exactly the same.

questions.prompt: Make the tune go **up**. Play the three white keys at the left end, moving to the right.
questions.hint: Going up means moving right. Start at the far-left key and move one white key at a time.

questions.prompt: Make the tune go **down**. Play the three white keys at the right end, moving to the left.
questions.hint: Going down means moving left. Start at the far-right key and move one white key at a time.

questions.prompt: You press keys one after another, moving from right to left. What shape is the tune?
questions.hint: Moving left makes the sound lower.

options.reason: Moving left makes the sound lower, not higher. Moving from right to left makes the tune go down.
Each new key makes a different sound. Staying the same needs the same key pressed again.

options.reason: Going up needs each sound to be higher than the one before. The same key makes the same sound every time.
Going down needs each sound to be lower than the one before. The same key makes the same sound every time.
